content.title: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID − Travel information − American Airlines
content.text: Save time at security If you’re an AAdvantage® member, you can opt in to use TSA PreCheck® Touchless ID. You’ll go through a dedicated security lane at participating airports where a camera scans your face to confirm your identity. It's a faster and easier way to go through security — no need to show a physical ID or mobile boarding pass. Learn how TSA uses facial ID technology Opens another site in a new window that may not meet accessibility guidelines. Getting started with Touchless ID To opt in, you must: Be an AAdvantage® member Have a Known Traveler Number (KTN) Have a valid passport Opt in to participate in TSA PreCheck® Touchless ID with American Airlines Download the American app Not an AAdvantage® member? Join for free Download the American Airlines app After opting in, you’ll stay enrolled in Touchless ID for 12 months. Where to opt in You can opt in: Any time in your AAdvantage® profile During check-in in the American app or ‘Ready to Fly’ hub if your flight departs from a participating airport How to opt in Before you check-in: Log in to your AAdvantage® account Find the ‘Information and password’ section to opt in Save your passport and Known Traveler Number Scroll to ‘TSA PreCheck® Touchless ID’ Check the opt-in box and save How to opt out You can opt out anytime by updating your AAdvantage® account preferences. If you’ve already checked in for an eligible flight, Touchless ID will still apply for that trip. Using Touchless ID at the airport When you arrive at the airport: Make sure you’ve checked in for your flight through the American app Look for the TSA PreCheck® Touchless ID symbol on your mobile boarding pass Go to the TSA PreCheck® Touchless ID security lane at participating airports You're welcome to use your physical ID at any time. Keep your mobile boarding pass ready in case you’re asked to show it before entering the lane. Airports with Touchless ID This content can be expanded
